name: tabor-artifacts-nature-body
title: Nature, the human body and dark matter
description: Nathan Tabor’s comparison of the world and the body, with the astronomy evidence alongside it.
sections: “the only place that dark matter is found is in the human body”

Astronomers infer dark matter from gravitational effects on ordinary matter and light. NASA describes mapping dark matter around galaxies and galaxy clusters through gravitational lensing. The composition of dark matter remains an open question.
Record an observed natural pattern, its proposed counterpart in the body, and the physical mechanism or source that could support the pairing.
